name: construct-iq-tracker
description: ConstructIQ Tracker — enterprise interior fit-out project, drawing, procurement and execution tracking platform.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ciq/shared && npm run build -w @ciq/api && npm run build -w @ciq/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ciq/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ciq/api && npm run typecheck -w @ciq/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ciq/shared && npm run test -w @ciq/api
scripts.bootstrap: npm install && npm run build -w @ciq/shared && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
